topic: Planning water stops on a self-supported route

content.hook: Plan your water stops before you ride

slides.title: Plan your *water stops* before you ride
slides.body: A calm, simple way to avoid running dry on a self-supported route.

slides.title: Mark water *before* you leave
slides.body: Scan the map for villages, petrol stations, campsites and public taps. Note them, and check the water is drinkable.

slides.title: Think in *segments*
slides.body: Cut the route into chunks of about 50 km. Know where you can refill in each one.

slides.title: Heat and wind change the *maths*
slides.body: Hot, windy or rough sections take longer and you drink more. Plan extra refill options there.

slides.title: Never rely on *one* source
slides.body: Taps break, shops close on Sundays, springs dry up. Pick a backup for every long gap.

slides.title: Treat *natural* water
slides.body: Streams and lakes need filtering or purifying. Carry a method you trust and know how to use it.

slides.title: Check *nearby* when plans change
slides.body: Missed a stop? Search for drinking water and shops nearby.

content.caption:
Running low on water is rarely about the bottle. It's about the plan.

Here's a calm way to plan water stops on a self-supported route:

1. Mark water points on the map before you leave, and check the water is drinkable.
2. Think in segments of about 50 km, and know where you can refill in each.
3. Heat, wind and rough surface slow you down and make you drink more. Plan extra options there.
4. Never rely on a single source. Taps break and shops close.
5. Treat natural water with a method you trust.
6. When plans change, look for water nearby.

Save this for your next trip planning session.

issues: Slide 2 lists cemeteries and public taps as water sources without saying to check the water is drinkable. Cemetery and public taps are often non-potable, so the advice needs a safety qualifier. Cemeteries removed and a potability check added.
Slide 7 says 'around your current location', which goes beyond the approved fact 'find water, food, bike repair and lodging nearby'. Reworded to 'nearby'.
Caption step 1 updated to match the drinkable-water check.
